A skill is a reusable set of task-specific instructions. The following skills are available in this session:

<available_skills>
- `assembling-the-team`: CEO team assembly: before any motion, pass these six steps (call anyone? / whom? / whom not? / capability inventory / which channel? / set the slug), then enter the chairing rhythm (chairing-staff-meeting).
- `chairing-staff-meeting`: CEO motion rhythm: clarify → DAG decomposition and dispatch → track progress → VP cross-review → close-out → bookkeeping (the roster and channels are decided first by assembling-the-team; this skill does not decide them again).
- `consulting-the-knowledge-map`: Reference wiki use: read index.md first, drill only the pages you need, grep when the index is thin, file synthesized answers back as pages, keep ingest/lint discipline, and never write into a wiki that lives outside the workspace.
- `delegation-policy`: Company delegation policy (core): do it yourself by default, the four brief elements, effort budget, chain design, result readability; how to use each channel comes from the capability section injected into this session.
- `fact-finding-playbook`: CEO external fact-finding playbook: when a motion needs outside facts, switch channels in this order (bash direct / mirrored copy / third-party teardown / podcast archive / index mining / browser fallback / DoH+IP direct); only after exhausting the list may you escalate to a human via HITL.
</available_skills>
